title: kate-ui: give a Unicode line break no width
summary: visual_row_count gives U+2028 and U+2029 a width of 0. A newline and a carriage return still have width 0. The test goes in the existing layout tests module.

lane.reason: A local Qwen3.8 coder model with 27B parameters on the owner Mac codes this packet. The change is one file and stays under about 60 lines.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: layout.rs has one test module named tests. Add the new test function at the end of that module, before its closing brace. Do not write a second mod tests. Keep visual_row_count pub(crate). Add is_line_break. The body is matches!(scalar, '\r' | '\n' | '\u{000B}' | '\u{000C}' | '\u{0085}' | '\u{2028}' | '\u{2029}'). Replace the else if with else if !is_line_break(scalar) { width = width.saturating_add(1); }. Do not nest an if inside an if. Do not touch notice_from, visible_line_range, or span_line_window. You may update the comment on visual_row_count so a line break has width 0. The existing tests a_carriage_return_has_no_width and a_newline_has_no_width stay green. Do not rewrite their assertions. The test a_unicode_line_break_has_no_width calls visual_row_count of ab, U+2028, cd with columns 4 and tab width 4 and gets 1. ab, U+2029, cd with columns 4 and tab width 4 gets 1. ab, a newline, cd stays 1. ab, a carriage return, cd stays 1. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip. Keep the change under about 60 lines. Run the full test module named in the commands, not only the new test.

regression_tests.name: layout::tests::a_unicode_line_break_has_no_width
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main. ab, U+2028, cd at 4 columns has 2 rows. After the change it has 1 row. A newline and a carriage return stay at 1 row.
